Subject: Birchley Outfitters - Quote Request

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the Birchley Outfitters submission! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward with quoting.

I have a few questions before I can finalize pricing:

1. Can you confirm the primary operations at each location?
2. What protective safeguards are in place (sprinklers, alarms, security)?
3. Are both buildings owner-occupied or tenant-occupied?
4. Any planned renovations or equipment upgrades in the next 12 months?
5. What are the construction types for each building?

Once I have these details, I'll work up competitive terms for the 12/26/26 effective date.

Thanks,
[Underwriter name]
